title: botrychium simplex var. compositum
intro: Botrychium simplex var. compositum, commonly known as rattlesnake fern, is a type of fern native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis, high blood pressure, and even certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of B. simplex var. compositum include inhibiting platelet aggregation, reducing blood pressure, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
